THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP A BUSINESS INCUBATOR. THE FASHION AND APPAREL BUSINESS "FAB" LABORATORY WILL SPECIFICALLY FOCUS ON FASHION DESIGN AND APPAREL ENTREPRENEURSHIP. THE FAB LAB WILL SUPPORT STUDENTS ENROLLED IN APPAREL, MERCHANDISING AND TEXTILES (AMTX) AT SOUTHERN UNIVERSITY AND A&M COLLEGE (SUBR) WISHING TO START OR IMPROVE ON AN EXISTING FASHION, APPAREL AND/OR TEXTILES RELATED SMALL BUSINESS. THE FAB LAB WILL ALSO TARGET MINORITY HIGH SCHOOL AGED YOUTH IN BATON ROUGE AND SURROUNDING RURAL AREAS. THIS UNDERSERVED POPULATION WILL LEARN ENTREPRENEURIAL SKILLS THROUGH A SUMMER YOUTH PROGRAM SPONSORED THROUGH THE FAB LAB.ALTHOUGH CURRENT TRENDS INDICATE THAT THERE IS A RISE IN ENTREPRENEURSHIP AMONG PEOPLE OF COLOR, MINORITIES STILL MAKE UP JUST 14.6% OF SMALL BUSINESS OWNERS IN THE U.S. (HECHT, 2014). MANY FACTORS UNDOUBTEDLY CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEARTH OF ENTREPRENEURIAL ACTIVITY AMONG WOMEN AND PEOPLE OF COLOR; ONE SIGNIFICANT FACTOR IS ENTREPRENEURIAL SELF-EFFICACY (ESE). ENTREPRENEURIAL SELF-EFFICACY REFERS TO AN INDIVIDUAL'S LEVEL OF SELF-CONFIDENCE OR THEIR BELIEF THAT THEY HAVE THE NECESSARY SKILLS AND ABILITIES TO SUCCEED IN CREATING A BUSINESS (BOYD & VOZIKIS, 1994). EVIDENCE INDICATES THAT ENTREPRENEURSHIP EDUCATION INITIATIVES HAVE A POSITIVE CORRELATION ON ESE AMONG MINORITIES THEREBY RESULTING IN A STRENGTHENED PIPELINE OF POTENTIAL ENTREPRENEURS AMONG THESE GROUPS (BRYANT, FABIAN, KINNAMON, & WRIGHT, 2012). FURTHER, THE ENHANCEMENT OF ESE IN CHILDREN AND ADOLESCENTS ALSO INCREASES THEIR DRIVE TO BECOME AN ENTREPRENEUR OR DISPLAY ENTREPRENEURIAL SKILL SETS (STUDDARD, DAWSON & JACKSON, 2011).RESIDENTS OF RURAL AREAS REPRESENT ANOTHER SEGMENT OF SOCIETY WHERE PARTICIPATION IN ENTREPRENEURIAL ACTIVITY IS LOW. RURAL AREAS PRESENT UNIQUE CONDITIONS THAT HAVE BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH ADVERSITY FOR RURAL ENTREPRENEURS AND SMALL BUSINESSES, INCLUDING LOWER LEVELS OF POPULATION DENSITY, CONSUMER INCOME, AND EDUCATIONAL ATTAINMENT (USDA, 2002). LOW POPULATION DENSITY HINDERS BUSINESS GROWTH, AND AS A RESULT, RURAL BUSINESSES TEND TO BE SMALL WITH A VAST MAJORITY OF OWNERS OPERATING BUSINESSES IN THEIR AREA RESIDENCE (KUGLER, MICHAELIDES, NANDA & AGBAYANI, 2017). RURAL COMMUNITIES LAG BEHIND CITIES IN INVESTMENTS IN INFRASTRUCTURE AND BANDWIDTH CAPACITY DUE TO REMOTENESS AND LOW POPULATION DENSITY WHICH OFTEN RESULTS IN REDUCED COMPUTER ACCESS AND USE (SHIELDS, 2005). IN ADDITION TO ENTREPRENEURSHIP EDUCATION, THE FAB LAB WILL PROVIDE UP-TO-DATE EQUIPMENT, TOOLS, MATERIALS AND RESOURCES USUALLY UNOBTAINABLE TO RURAL RESIDENTS TO FOSTER THE DEVELOPMENT OF SUSTAINABLE FASHION AND APPAREL BUSINESSES WITHIN THEREGION.

A SERIOUS ENVIRONMENTAL ISSUE CONFRONTING THE STATE OF FLORIDA, AS WELL AS THE NATION, IS THE DECLINING HEALTH OF SPRINGS AND SPRING RUNS DUE TO VARIOUS ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS (AND THEIR INTERACTIONS) THAT INCLUDE GROUNDWATER DEPLETION, NUTRIENT ENRICHMENT, FLOW REDUCTION, INVASIVE SPECIES (E.G., HYDRILLA), AND INCREASED ALGAL GROWTH. THISPROJECT FOCUSESON SPRINGS AND SPRING-FED STREAMS OF FORESTED WATERSHEDS OF PUBLIC LANDS WITHIN THE UPPER HEADWATER PORTIONS OF THE ST. MARKS RIVER BASIN, WHICH IS LOCATED IN THE NORTH FLORIDA PANHANDLE. THE OVERARCHING GOAL OF THE PROJECT IS TO BUILD INSTITUTIONAL CAPACITY IN WATERSHED RESEARCH THROUGH THE INVESTIGATION OF AQUATIC INDICATOR SPECIES AT THE WATERSHED SCALE. FIELD SURVEYS WILL BE CARRIED OUT TO COLLECT IMPORTANT BASELINE DATA ON THE AQUATIC INSECT AND AQUATIC PLANT DIVERSITY. FIELD-SURVEY DATA WILL THEN BE ANALYZED TO DETERMINE AQUATIC INSECT SPECIES THAT ARE THE BEST BIOINDICATORS OF HEALTHY AQUATIC HABITATS WITHIN THE BASIN. THE RESPONSES OF AQUATIC BIOINDICATOR SPECIES TO CHANGES IN ENVIRONMENTAL PARAMETERS (E.G., WATER TEMPERATURE, DISSOLVED OXYGEN, FLOW RATES) WILL BE INVESTIGATED FURTHER UNDER FIELD AND CONTROLLED LABORATORY SETTINGS. THE BIODIVERSITY SURVEY DATA AND BIOPHYSICAL DATA (FIELD AND LABORATORY) WILL BE INTEGRATED AND DEVELOPED INTO A NOVEL CONCEPTUAL MODEL, SO-NAMED THE BIOPHYSICAL INDICATOR-SPECIES MODEL (BISM). THE MODEL WILL USED AS A TOOL FOR GUIDING LAND USE/FOREST MANAGEMENT PRACTICES THAT HELP TO ENHANCE WATER RESOURCES BY MAKING THEM MORE SUSTAINABLE AND RESILIENT TO CLIMATE CHANGE.

**AWARDS ISSUED PRIOR TO JANUARY 20, 2025, WERE FUNDED UNDER PREVIOUS ADMINISTRATIONS AND MAY NOT REFLECT THE PRIORITIES AND POLICIES OF THE CURRENT ADMINISTRATION.** THE GOAL OF THE PROJECT IS TO UTILIZE TECHNIQUES IN PRECISION BREEDING AND GENOME EDITING FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF POWDERY MILDEW RESISTANT GRAPE CULTIVARS. GRAPEVINE IS AFFECTED BY SEVERAL FUNGAL DISEASES, WHICH ARE A SERIOUS THREAT TO GRAPE PRODUCTION WORLDWIDE. AMONG THE FUNGAL DISEASES AFFECTING GRAPEVINE, POWDERY MILDEW IS THE MOST DEVASTATING DISEASE WORLDWIDE. SPECIFIC OBJECTIVES INCLUDE 1) IDENTIFICATION AND ISOLATION OF TARGET MLO CANDIDATE GENES FROM THE VITIS GENOME FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF CRISPR/CAS9 CONSTRUCTS, 2) TARGETING MLO GENES IN EMBRYOGENIC CULTURES TO GENERATE EDITED GRAPE PLANT LINES, 3) GREENHOUSE SCREENING OF EDITED PLANT LINES TO POWDERY MILDEW RESISTANCE AND 4) QUANTIFYING PLANT RESPONSE TO POWDERY MILDEW INFECTION USING SCANNING ELECTRON MICROSCOPY.THE PROJECT UTILIZES GRAPE GENOME INFORMATION ALONG WITH GENOME EDITING TECHNOLOGY TO GENERATE TARGETED MUTATIONS WHILE KEEPING DESIRED VITICULTURAL TRAITS INTACT. GENOME EDITING, WHICH INVOLVES MODIFICATION OF DNA SEQUENCES SOLELY FROM THE GRAPE GENOME, IS CONSUMER AND ECOFRIENDLY INASMUCH IT DISRUPTS THE GENOME MUCH LESS THAN TRADITIONAL BREEDING AND SHOULD CAUSE NO GMO-RELATED CONCERNS. DISEASE RESISTANT GRAPE CULTIVARS WILL PROVIDE MAJOR ADVANTAGES SUCH AS DECREASED PRODUCTION COSTS, DRAMATICALLY REDUCING THE AMOUNT OF FUNGICIDES THEREBY LOWERING EXPOSURE OF WORKERS AND NON-TARGET ORGANISMS, AND IMPROVEMENT OF BIODIVERSITY IN VINEYARDS. THE PROJECT WILL PROVIDE OPPORTUNITIES TO MINORITY GRADUATE AND UNDERGRADUATE STUDENTS THEREBY ENHANCING CAPACITY BUILDING IN RESEARCH AND TEACHING. MULTI-DISCIPLINARY EXPERTISE OF COLLABORATORS WILL COMPLEMENT INDIVIDUAL PROGRAMS AND EXPAND CUTTING EDGE RESEARCH IN AREAS OF GENOMICS AND PLANT BREEDING THAT CAN BE UTILIZED BY 1890 INSTITUTIONS FOR MINORITY STUDENT RESEARCH AND TRAINING.
